subject: Can this tool be applied to amplicon sequencing data

messages.author: b900501df12ec262
messages.subject: Can this tool be applied to amplicon sequencing data
parts:
Hi,

I can tell from the description, CODEX is suitable for target-capture based sequencing data, but can it be also applied to amplicon data?

Thanks,

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: [codex_wes_cnv] Can this tool be applied to amplicon sequencing data
parts:
Hi,

I’m not sure of the amplicon pipeline but if it is target-capture based and if it introduces low-rank noise in the sequencing depth, then yes you can use CODEX. One thing to bear in mind is that you need multiple samples (from our experience > 30) to estimate the target- and sample-wise latent factors.

Hope that this helps,
Yuchao
